tasks.title: Conversation #68
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Customer support. How may I help you?
Man: Well, my computer keeps overheating and shutting down.
Woman: Have you checked if the fans are working properly? Dust can accumulate and block air flow.
Man: I haven't looked at that.
Woman: You can get a can of compressed air and spray it into the vents and the fans to blow out the dust.
Man: OK I'll try that.
Woman: Hopefully that'll take care of the problem. If not, you'll probably need to ship it to us so we can take a look.

questions.stem: What problem the man is experiencing with his computer?
questions.analysis: 答案： C 题目问的是: 男士的电脑遇到了什么问题？ 定位原文: Man: "Well, my computer keeps overheating and shutting down." 选项分析: A. It is running slowly. (运行缓慢。) - 错误。虽然过热可能导致降频变慢，但男士明确描述的问题是过热。 B. The screen is flickering. (屏幕闪烁。) - 错误。文中未提及。 C. It is overheating. (过热。) - 正确。男士直接使用了 "overheating" 这个词。 D. The battery is not charging. (电池不充电。) - 错误。文中未提及。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do?

options.D: Bring it to a computer repair shop

questions.analysis: 答案： B 题目问的是: 女士建议男士做什么？ 定位原文: Woman: "You can get a can of compressed air and spray it into the vents and the fans to blow out the dust." 选项分析: A. Replace the battery (更换电池) - 错误。文中未提及。 B. Clean the fans (清洁风扇) - 正确。女士建议用压缩空气吹出风扇和通风口的灰尘，即清洁风扇。 C. Update the operating system (更新操作系统) - 错误。文中未提及软件更新。 D. Bring it to a computer repair shop (把它带到电脑修理店) - 错误。女士建议的是 "ship it to us"（寄给我们/客服），而不是去当地的修理店。
